scenario.title: Reporting a Repair Problem to Your Landlord
scenario.description: You have been renting an apartment from Ms. Rivera for about six months. Last week the kitchen faucet started leaking, and a repair worker she sent came by but did not finish the job. Water is now dripping into the cabinet under the sink.
scenario.subject: Kitchen faucet still leaking
scenario.purpose: Report an unfinished repair and arrange for it to be completed
keyPoints: Say something positive about living in the apartment
Explain what went wrong with the repair
Ask when the problem can be fixed and suggest a time that works for you

modelAnswer:
Dear Ms. Rivera,

I hope you are doing well. I have really enjoyed my first six months here; the building is quiet, and you have always responded quickly whenever I needed anything.

I am writing because the leak in the kitchen is still not fixed. The plumber who came on Tuesday replaced a washer, but he said he needed a different part and would return the next day. He never came back, and now water is collecting in the cabinet below the sink. I have put a bucket there, but I am worried the wood will be damaged.

Could you let me know when someone might be able to finish the job? I am home every weekday after 4 p.m., and I would also be happy to leave a key with the building manager if that is easier.

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Daniel

rubric.description: Gives friendly context, clearly explains the unfinished repair, and makes a specific request with availability.
Opens with a greeting and positive note, moves logically to the problem, and closes with a request and thanks.
Polite but direct tone suitable for a tenant writing to a landlord; varied sentences and precise vocabulary.
